playlists.name: Beginner
playlists.description: Chains, one functional group at a time, then branches, acids and rings.

playlists.name: Longer chains, more groups
playlists.description: Up to nine carbons. Groups move off carbon 1, then come two at a time.

playlists.name: Rings with groups
playlists.description: Cycloalkanes and benzenes carrying functional groups.

playlists.name: Heterocycles
playlists.description: Rings with N, O or S in them. The heteroatom is atom 1.

playlists.name: Medicine cabinet
playlists.description: Substituted benzenes up to aspirin, benzocaine, paracetamol and lidocaine.

playlists.name: Caffeine and cousins
playlists.description: One fused ring system, four molecules. Only the methyl locants change.
